.Notes
[[sep-components-note-1]]^[1]^ An access to an unmapped offset also latches PIC source 41. +
[[sep-components-note-2]]^[2]^ Up to offset 0x1FF the DMA answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PIC source 41. +
[[sep-components-note-3]]^[3]^ Up to offset 0x3F the timer answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PERIPH_BUS_ERR_STATUS.wdt, one of the bits behind PIC source 43. +
[[sep-components-note-4]]^[4]^ Up to offset 0xFF the AES answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PERIPH_BUS_ERR_STATUS.aes, one of the bits behind PIC source 43. +
[[sep-components-note-5]]^[5]^ Up to offset 0x7F the EDN answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PERIPH_BUS_ERR_STATUS.edn, one of the bits behind PIC source 43. +
[[sep-components-note-6]]^[6]^ Up to offset 0x7F the CSRNG answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PERIPH_BUS_ERR_STATUS.csrng, one of the bits behind PIC source 43. +
[[sep-components-note-7]]^[7]^ With no TRNG fitted, the reference integration answers DECERR, 0xBADCAB1E / DECERR. +
[[sep-components-note-8]]^[8]^ A 32-bit read of the upper word of a register also answers SLVERR, 0x0. +
[[sep-components-note-9]]^[9]^ Up to offset 0x3F the SPI controller answers with read data 0xFFFFFFFF and also latches PERIPH_BUS_ERR_STATUS.spi, one of the bits behind PIC source 43.
